protocol.candidate_rule: union(dense top20, CE top20) minus frozen top10; order by best rank (tie: dense before CE, then docid); keep top 3
protocol.comparison_rule: each candidate vs frozen ranks 8,9,10 (<= 9 pairs)
protocol.swap_rule: at most one swap per query, other ranks frozen
protocol.zscore_convention: per-query z over the CE run file (deployment w=1)
